#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    int cur = 0, len = 0, ans = 0, insideWords = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char ch = s[i];
        switch (ch) {
            case '(':
            case ')':
            case '_':
                if (len > 0) {
                    if (cur == 1) insideWords++;
                    else ans = max(ans, len);
                    len = 0;
                }
                if (ch == '(') cur = 1;
                if (ch == ')') cur = 0;
                break;
            default:
                len++;
        }
    }

    ans = max(ans, len);
    cout << ans << " " << insideWords << endl;

    return 0;
}
